phase: Phase 2: Green — the updates and the lock file
summary: The package and lock updates pass scope and dependency checks, but axe-core, Playwright, and Vitest updates can change scored probe or suite outcomes within the active cohort.
blocking_findings: Revert axe-core 4.14.1 to 4.13.0 for score comparability. probes.spec.ts loads axe-core and P.axe-clean is a tier-2 scored probe; axe-core 4.14.0 enables label-content-name-mismatch by default, and later releases fix aria-valid-attr-value behavior. These changes can change which candidate violations are reported. Evidence: harness/tests/e2e/probes.spec.ts:163-192, harness/tests/criteria.ts:129, SCORING.md:87-97, axe-core v4.14.0/v4.14.1 changelog. | CONTEST kept: the pinned checker is part of the scored probe, and the upstream changelog documents score-affecting rule behavior changes.

Revert @playwright/test 1.65.1 to 1.62.1 for score comparability. Playwright runs scored browser probes and its JSON report is collected into benchmark results; the version check and smoke spec proposed for task 3.1 do not establish equivalent probe outcomes across versions. Evidence: harness/playwright.config.ts:23, harness/tests/e2e/probes.spec.ts:1-3 and 185-193, SCORING.md:38-48. | CONTEST kept: this is a score-driving runner, and no equivalent-results evidence covers the version change.

Revert Vitest 4.1.12 to 4.1.10 for score comparability. The grading pipeline consumes Vitest JSON outcomes; changing the runner can change candidate suite results and therefore scores. Evidence: harness/tests-track/grade-tests.ts:82-129, harness/tests-track/grade-tests.ts:215-260, harness/vitest.config.ts:26. The targeted meta test proves the refreshed runner starts, not that scored outcomes remain equivalent. | CONTEST kept: the test runner is an input to score calculation, and the recorded quick runner test does not compare outcomes with the old pin.
